text:
Dear Larkspur team,

I am writing to inquire about hiring the Tindall Skylark for a period drama shoot, which requires the aircraft to be available on Tuesday 11 March 2027. We anticipate needing it from 09:30 until 7:00 pm. Could you please arrange for it to be taken to Hollowmere Abbey, from where it will be collected afterwards.

Sincerely,
Cora Fennimore
